text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente wasn't feeling well, so I brought her to a shrine for a change of pace.
choice_data_list: Shall we go visit the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'll hold off.
I don't feel like I can approach this with an open heart today..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a coincidence. Doesn't look like you're... out training, though.
choice_data_list: Just to blow off some steam, you know?
Just to blow off some steam, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
You seem to have been off your game lately, Dura.
Even when I saw you on campusâ"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No, that is not the case.
I am in peak condition."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Still putting on a brave face, are you...? In that case――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dura, would you keep me company for a bit?
Meeting you here brought back old memories.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I don't mind, but what are you...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There's a logging trail behind the shrine grounds, right?
—Let's play tag."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dura, you remember too, right?
We used to do this all the time
during our outdoor training back at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's been a while since I felt like playing a game with you.
You're "it". Now, chase after me just like back then—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just try and catch me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come on, at this rate,
you'll never catch up!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Not yet!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...!
Did she just shift up a gear...!
And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now that's a much better look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, the look in your eyes has changed.
Good expression. Very Dura-like.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much.
It's all thanks to... big sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No matter how much time passes, I'm still no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the game of tag,
Duramente was able to regain her stride.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Child A
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
Over here, Mr. Demon~!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Child B
text_block_list.text: Waaaiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Looks like someone beat us here. We'd only be in the way if we stayed.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Our timing was bad this time.
...Let's try again another time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she felt unsatisfied with how it ended,
Duramente was unable to regain her form.
